full_page.content:
1933, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 114 May 31 Helen Pagel - 35 May 1 - expecting to lose her breast - cancer oper- ation goes to Ann Arbor To-day ...
Page 115
1933, June
June 7 Albert McCatty
Maurice Bazinot - 40 - Work
Mrs. Amalia Gloss - 64 last Sunday - tumor on top of head - daughter non C. - husband, a decorator - struggling to make ends meet.
David Baker again - 49 - in clinic, Stroke - hemorage, now pneumonia - Wife quite changed - found to have been a Catholic
Mrs. G. Hagedorn - 53 - fears gall-stone opera - told her we'd pray for her ... she should make the novena to St. Anthony first - then see
Mrs. Cath Thorp - 68 - dizzy
Frank Muehl & Wife - 25 - not practicing their faith - unhappy - Father non Cath.
Mrs. Antoinette Fuhrman - 52 - lost left breast last Nov. On May 6 last month lost right breast. Last Friday in agony. Dr. thought she'd never get out of bed. Fr. X gave her blessing last Friday and enrolled her in S.M.A. - next day sat up.
Baby Paul Rutt - 7 mo. Exima, ulcer on back of head - touch of pneu- monia, now another ulcer seems to be forming, the fever is lower.
Mrs. M. - 69 - once pius mother ... fallen to every kind of intemper- ance - love of money at root ... daughter discouraged ....
Mable Brown - 60 - non Cath - Cancer on cheekbone.
Mr. Bliven - 78 - Vericose Veins .... Mrs. Chandler - 68 - special Int ..
Page 116 Blank Page
Page 117 June Paul Janisse - 22 of Windsor - brain defect feared.
